title: Partner Market Rate Schedule for Cleaning and Damage Fees Work Orders
content:
**Rule.** The metro rate of a Wayfare partner work order on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report is read from the market the reported trip started in: Denver, Las Vegas and Salt Lake City take the high-cost metro rate; Colorado Springs, Phoenix and Tucson take the mid-cost metro rate; any other market takes a rate of one.

| Market the trip started in | Code on the trip record | Metro rate |
|---|---|---|
| Denver, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City | DEN, LAS, SLC | 1.1 (high-cost) |
| Colorado Springs, Phoenix, Tucson | COS, PHX, TUS | 1.05 (mid-cost) |
| Albuquerque, or any other market | ABQ or other | 1 |

The market is the metro market on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).

**What the rate multiplies.** The metro rate multiplies the price of the interior service on the work order.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A work order whose interior service is priced at $165.00, on a trip that started in Denver: $165.00 multiplied by 1.1, that is $181.50. The same order on a trip that started in Phoenix: $165.00 multiplied by 1.05, that is $173.25.
